summary: Washburn County, WI tower that FFLA and a second Wisconsin list show as standing; no build date, owner or history found in the sources reached.

evidence.supports: FFLA lists the Shelton tower in Washburn County as standing at the stated coordinates
a second list places a Shelton tower in Washburn County, with no other detail
WJFW reports Wisconsin's 72 fire towers were decommissioned in 2015
evidence.quote: In 2015, the 72 aging towers still in use were decommissioned.

evidence.supports: the DNR planned to take its 72 towers out of service in 2016
evidence.quote: Seventy-two fire towers (mostly in Northern Wisconsin) used by the Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources (DNR), including five in Sawyer County, will be taken out of service in 2016

sources.title: Connecting the dots: the fire towers of Wisconsin
DNR will discontinue fire towers in 2016

resolved_conflicts.explanation: WJFW says Wisconsin's 72 towers were decommissioned in 2015; the Sawyer County Record reports the DNR planned to take its towers out of service in 2016. Neither names Shelton, so the story gives both dates and does not link this tower to either.

notes_for_editor: Only two lists document this tower; no build date, owner, history or access source. Neither the DNR article nor the WJFW piece names Shelton, so it is unknown whether it was one of the DNR's 72 towers. Do not add access or condition claims without a new source.
